images.caption: The Charminar is a monument in Hyderabad, India. The structure was built in 1591 AD. It is the most famous building of Hyderabad and also one of the most famous buildings in India. It was built by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shahi to celebrate the end of a deadly plague.

images.caption: Charminar, an example of Islamic architecture location in the southern city of India, Hyderabad. Char is number which means four and minar means Minaret, so this is a monument having four Minarets. This was constructed in 1591 by founder of city Hyderabad Muhammad Quli Qutub Shah. This heritage building and mosque is the global recognition of city Hyderabad. Most prominent location in Hyderabad and surrounds with traditional market like jewels, gems, gemstone, dress, bangles, food, tea, and many more.
